confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rest on scattered 2025-2026 Annecy menu listings and a France-wide café reference, so they are indicative only. Wine and cocktail prices are weakly sourced and were set from the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Euro figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR from general knowledge, not from the RBA observation. The RBA value is stale: the search did not confirm a current observation, and a later third-party figure could not be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Annecy is a mid-sized lakeside Alpine tourist town in France. Food anchors use Annecy restaurant ranges (Gault&Millau and the local tourism office) and France-wide café references. Drink anchors are estimated from the local beer price. Accommodation anchors use a July peak-season holistic estimate for a lakeside Alpine tourist town.
